Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, and positive urine culture for >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, consistent with a urinary tract infection. Hematuria is present. Low urine specific gravity and acidic pH may reflect dilution and/or infection. No casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antimicrobial therapy.
